title: Design apply-schema API endpoint specification
description: Design the backend API endpoint specification for applying DDL to PostgreSQL, including request/response format and safety constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Request includes DDL statements and target schema
Response includes success/failure and error message
No-drops constraint is enforced at API level
Error handling for DDL failures is defined

evidence: Created docs/api/apply-schema.md specifying the POST /api/v1/apply-schema endpoint: request format (host, port, database, user, password, schema, ddl, confirm), response format (success/failure + error message), status codes (200/400/401/502/503/504/500), API-level no-drops constraint (reject DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER), and error handling for DDL failures.

All five acceptance criteria covered: (1) endpoint documented (§1 Overview), (2) request includes DDL statements and target schema (§2 fields ddl/schema), (3) response includes success/failure and error message (§3 Response Format), (4) no-drops constraint enforced at API level (§5 + §4.4), (5) error handling for DDL failures defined (§4 + §4.8). Acceptance criteria mapping table in §8.
